title: Red Hat Security Advisory: git-lfs security update
description: Red Hat issued a security advisory for git-lfs addressing three denial of service vulnerabilities originating from components of the Go programming language used within git-lfs. These include excessive recursion in ASN.1 unmarshalling, indefinite KeyUpdate messages in crypto/tls, and excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames in net/http. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 on multiple architectures.
